Rebuilding the widget cache

This article describes how to rebuild the widget cache after a failed nightly job.

Stop the worker, drain the queue, then run the rebuild on a single host.

  • Confirm the cache entry counts match the manifest.
  • Do not re-enable the nightly job until the counts agree twice.

The page has no repeated author or timestamp structure.

End of article.
